title: Major tech outages raise new cybersecurity concerns
summary: "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley examine a series of recent technology outages affecting Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), JPMorgan Chase (JPM), and the National Security Agency (NSA). The panel explores the cybersecurity concerns posed by these disruptions and what they reveal about vulnerabilities in critical digital infrastructure.
